questions.stem: 看到明星完美的照片，連年輕人也開始購買抗老產品（anti-aging products），這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展。
questions.answer: Seeing perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, which has caused the anti-aging industry to boom.
accepted_answers: After seeing the perfect photos of stars, even young people have begun to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry thrive.
Having seen celebrities' perfect pictures, even young people have started to buy anti-aging products, which has led to a boom in the anti-aging industry.
Seeing the perfect pictures of celebrities, even young people have begun buying anti-aging products, which has helped the anti-aging industry flourish.

patterns: 分詞構句（句首 V-ing／After V-ing）
非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整句）

questions.stem: 擔心自己顯老，許多消費者花大錢買這些產品，卻從不想想它們是否真的有效。
questions.answer: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a fortune on these products but never think about whether they really work.
accepted_answers: Worried that they look old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products without ever asking whether they are truly effective.
Worrying about looking old, many consumers spend large sums of money on these products but never consider whether they actually work.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）

1.explanation_zh: 「看到明星完美的照片」沒有主詞，做這個動作的其實是後面的「年輕人」，所以用分詞構句 Seeing …, even young people …；保留連接詞寫成 After seeing …、或用完成分詞 Having seen … 也可以。「連…也」用 even 放在名詞前；「開始購買」用現在完成式 have started buying／have begun to buy 表示到現在的趨勢。「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which has caused／made …（which 指整個子句）；made 後面接原形動詞，caused 後面接 to + 原形。「蓬勃發展」用 boom、thrive、flourish 都可以，也可以名詞化成 which has led to a boom in the anti-aging industry。句尾分詞 , causing the anti-aging industry to boom 文法也正確，但這一句的標的句型是 which 子句。
evidence: 這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展
1.strategy_zh: 句首沒有主詞的動作（看到…、聽到…）→ 先想分詞構句 V-ing …；「…，這讓／這使得…」→ , which + V …（which 指前面整句）。
hints: 切成四段：看到明星完美的照片／連年輕人也開始購買抗老產品／這讓／抗老產業蓬勃發展
標的詞彙：see（看到）、perfect（完美的）、photo（照片）、celebrity（明星，也可用 star）、young（年輕的）、buy（購買）、industry（產業）、boom（蓬勃發展，也可用 thrive、flourish）
句型框架：V-ing …, even + S + have started V-ing …, which has caused + O + to V

2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」是後面「許多消費者」的心理狀態，用過去分詞開頭的分詞構句 Worried about looking old,（＝Because they are worried about looking old）；about 後面接動名詞。「花大錢買…」用 spend a fortune／a lot of money on …。「卻從不想想」可寫 but never think about，或 without ever asking。「是否真的有效」是 think about 的受詞，用 whether 引導的名詞子句，語序是 whether + they + really work（直述句）；「有效」可用動詞 work 或形容詞 effective。
2.strategy_zh: 「是否…」當受詞 → whether + S + V（不倒裝）；「花錢在…上」→ spend + 錢 + on + N。
hints: 切成四段：擔心自己顯老／許多消費者花大錢買這些產品／卻從不想想／它們是否真的有效
標的詞彙：worry（擔心）、old（老的）、consumer（消費者）、spend（花錢）、fortune（大筆錢）、product（產品）、think（想）、work（有效）
句型框架：Worried about V-ing …, S + spend a fortune on … but never think about whether + S + V

Having seen celebrities' perfect pictures, even young people have started to buy anti-aging products, which has led to a boom in the anti-aging industry.
Seeing the perfect pictures of celebrities, even young people have begun buying anti-aging products, which has helped the anti-aging industry flourish.

common_errors.wrong: the anti-aging industry develop prosperously
common_errors.right: the anti-aging industry boom
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「蓬勃發展」不要逐字拆成 develop prosperously，英文一個動詞 boom／thrive／flourish（或名詞 a boom in …）就能表達。

traps.literal_error: See perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started buying anti-aging products, …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文句首「看到…」省略主詞，英文不能讓原形動詞開頭又接另一個子句；改用分詞構句 Seeing …（或 After seeing …），邏輯主詞＝後面的 young people。

traps.literal_error: …, which makes the anti-aging industry develop prosperously.
traps.explanation_zh: 「蓬勃發展」是複合概念，照字面拆成 develop + prosperously 很不自然；英文用一個動詞 boom、thrive、flourish，或名詞 a boom in …。

bonus.text: So perfect do celebrities look in their photos that even young people have started buying anti-aging products, fueling a boom in the industry.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 形容詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 … that …（倒裝）強調「明星看起來完美到…」；句尾 fueling a boom in … 用分詞片語表結果。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展」的「這」指前面整件事，英文不另起一句用 this，而是接成非限定關係子句 , which has caused …；「蓬勃發展」可以用動詞 boom、thrive、flourish，也可以名詞化成 a boom in the anti-aging industry。

traps.literal_error: Worry about look old, many consumers spend …
traps.explanation_zh: 句首的「擔心」沒有主詞，英文要變成分詞 Worried／Worrying，不能用原形動詞開頭；「顯老」是 look old，about 後面要用動名詞 looking。

traps.explanation_zh: 「花大錢」英文是 spend a fortune／a lot of money on …；big money 是逐字直譯，spend 的錢後面用 on + 東西。

bonus.text: Worried about looking old, many consumers pour money into these products; rarely do they stop to ask whether the products really work.
bonus.explanation_zh: pour money into …（把錢大把砸進…）是生動的搭配；否定副詞 rarely 放句首要倒裝（do + 主詞 + 原形動詞）。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「卻從不想想…」可以改用介系詞片語 without ever asking whether …，把兩個動作併進同一個子句。

1.translation: Seeing the perfect photos of celebrities, even young people have started to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry boom.
1.explanation_zh: 「看到明星完美的照片」主詞與主要子句相同（年輕人），用現在分詞構句 Seeing… 開頭；「開始」是延續到現在的新趨勢，用現在完成式 have started；「這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展」承接前面整件事，用 , which has made… boom 的非限定關係子句；「連」譯 even 放在主詞前。

2.translation: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend a lot of money on these products but never think about whether they really work.
2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」是消費者的心理狀態，用過去分詞（形容詞）構句 Worried about looking old 開頭；「花大錢買」用 spend a lot of money on；「卻從不想想…是否」用 but never think about + whether 名詞子句；「有效」譯 work（也可 are effective）；描述一般現象用現在簡單式。

1.translation: Seeing celebrities' perfect photos, even young people have begun to buy anti-aging products, which has made the anti-aging industry flourish.
1.explanation_zh: 「看到……」是句首的分詞構句，隱含主詞與主要子句相同（young people），所以用 Seeing 開頭沒有懸垂問題。「開始購買」用現在完成式 have begun to buy，因為這是持續到現在的趨勢，也和後面的結果相呼應。「這讓抗老產業蓬勃發展」用 which 引導的非限定子句，指前面整件事，動詞用 has made ... flourish（使役動詞接原形）。「連年輕人也」用 even 放在 young people 前面。

2.translation: Worried about looking old, many consumers spend large sums of money on these products without ever stopping to think whether they are really effective.
2.explanation_zh: 「擔心自己顯老」用 Worried about looking old 當句首分詞片語（形容詞片語表原因），主詞 many consumers 與之一致。「花大錢」用 spend large sums of money on。「卻從不想想」帶有轉折與否定，用 without ever stopping to think whether ... 最簡潔自然；「它們是否真的有效」是 whether 子句，they 指前面的 products，時態用現在式。

issues_zh: 第 3 部分「卻從不想想」的 accepted 只收「think about」「stopping to think about」「ask」「consider」等寫法，沒有收不帶 about 的 think whether／stop to think whether（我的譯文 without ever stopping to think whether they are really effective 文法自然正確，但 part 3 比對不到）。
建議在 part 3 補上 without ever stopping to think、but never stop to think、but never think，並讓 part 4 的 whether 子句可以直接接在 think 後面，避免把自然的寫法判成不在可接受範圍內。
